description: This file defines the class HTTP_WebDAV_Server_vCal which extends HTTP_WebDAV_Server to implement WebDAV filesystem access specifically for vCal (calendar) data. It handles HTTP methods like GET and PUT to serve and update calendar data, along with authentication and request parsing tailored for vCal interactions within a SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server_vCal
classes.description: A class implementing WebDAV server support for vCal data, enabling calendar sharing via WebDAV in SuiteCRM with methods for handling requests, authentication, and data storage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the vCal WebDAV server, creating new bean instances for calendar and user focus.

methods.name: ServeRequest
methods.description: Main entry point to process a WebDAV request, including authentication, path parsing, and setting up the context for vCal data access.

methods.name: check_auth
methods.description: Handles HTTP basic authentication either via session or publish key, with fallback to login authentication.

methods.name: http_GET
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests; returns free/busy calendar data in vCal format based on the current configuration.

methods.name: http_PUT
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update or create vCal data, including request validation, lock checking, and content storage.

methods.name: PUT
methods.description: Placeholder for additional PUT process handling if needed.

methods.name: checkLock
methods.description: Checks resource locks; currently always returns false, indicating no lock is enforced.
